text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while Shinko Windy is<n>having lunch with a
friend...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Huh?! It's n-n-n-nothing! It doesn't<n>hurt at all!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uh, I mean, sure it hurts, but it's not<n>my teeth! I
definitely don't have a<n>cavity!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way I'm going to some crummy<n>dentist!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her tooth pain turns out to be<n>just the result
of biting too hard,<n>Windy's day is nonetheless
ruined<n>by an unwanted visit to the dentist.
